👁 It sees you before you see it, and it tells everyone. Take the shot before the cawing starts — after that, the whole woods knows where you're standing.

🌿 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

🌿 Violet checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 60s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 30s asks "We've been walking past those." Violet says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

"Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jayden says quietly "Say that again — slower." Sam says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Desmond leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about White Noise. Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are."
